subject: Cutover staffing and communication clarifications for v1 -> v2 model phase
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cutover staffing and communication clarifications for v1 -> v2 model phase

Team —

Quick note as we finalize the v1->v2 cutover runway: we need clarity on two things before I sign off on the cutover calendar next week.

1) Staffing alignment: who is the primary on-call for the 48h immediate cutover window and who handles customer L1 routing? I sketched a tentative matrix and attached it (cutover_staffing_matrix.xlsx).

2) Comms ownership: MarComs has a doc draft but we need product + legal sign-off. Who will shepherd the customer-facing timeline + exemption language for accounts with pinned models?

We have at least three enterprise customers (Acme, BigCorp, CloudCo partner pilots) who asked for a precise SLA fallback plan; Laura, can you confirm if we should treat Acme as a priority canary?

I want to lock the calendar by EOD Tuesday (9/19). If you can reply with owners and a short gap analysis today that'd be ideal.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover staffing and communication clarifications for v1 -> v2 model phase

Sergio —

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the attached matrix and added two notes:

- Ops coverage: Ben should be primary for the initial 48h; I'll be secondary for escalation/CS coordination.
- Comms: I'll take first pass on customer-facing language but we need legal to vet the "pinned model" exception wording; I've added placeholders in comms-draft-v1v2.docx.

Proposed phased timeline (high level):
- Phase 0 (internal canary): 09/26 - small internal traffic only, confirm metrics
- Phase 1 (priority customers): 10/03 - Acme + CloudCo pilots
- Phase 2 (general rollout): 10/10 - scheduled cutover for public endpoints

Open questions:
- Are we comfortable with a 7-day rollback window for priority customers, or do we need a longer exemption lane?
- Do we want an automated fallback to v1 for specific traffic classes (by account id) or manual routing?

I'll attach a short risk matrix later today.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Model Rollouts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover staffing and communication clarifications for v1 -> v2 model phase

Agree with Marissa's ops plan. A couple of operational constraints to flag:

- Capacity: the v2 kernels spike memory usage under long-context requests; the initial internal canary must enforce a token cap of 4k or we'll blow planned pool headroom.
- Canary rollout needs a clear rollback trigger set (latency p95 > 450ms or error rate > 1%). I can implement the automated fallback but need the precise thresholds and the list of account ids to include in the routing policy.

I also recommend we reserve a small dedicated pool for the priority customers during Phase 1 to avoid noisy-neighbor issues. If leadership approves, that needs a commit by 09/21 to secure capacity.

-Ben
Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, aisha.gomez@acme.com
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover staffing and communication clarifications for v1 -> v2 model phase

Looping in Acme contact for confirmation. Acme has requested the following before agreeing to Phase 1 as canary:

- A formal rollback SLA: ability to revert traffic within 2 hours if outputs materially regress for named tests (ML regression suite).
- A dedicated Slack channel with a Redwood on-call during their business hours (US EST).

Acme also asked for an updated pricing addendum if usage patterns change post-cutover. Procurement at BigCorp is on a parallel path; I included procurement@bigcorp.com for visibility.

If we can't meet the 2-hour rollback SLA, Acme will ask to remain on pinned v1 for the next quarter. That's why we should be careful about the capacity reservation ask Ben raised.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Shaw <tim.shaw@cloudco.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cutover staffing and communication clarifications for v1 -> v2 model phase

Thanks for the transparency, Laura and Sergio. A few clarifications from Acme:

- We'll run our regression suite the week prior to Phase 1. If Redwood can commit to the 2-hour revert + a named contact for the channel we'll be comfortable being the canary.
- For the pricing addendum: we'd prefer a temporary usage credit approach rather than a long-term price change; procurement at our end will surface the exact ask by 09/20.

I'll confirm once our procurement team signs off. In the meantime, please share the final canary account list and the rollback triggers so our engineers can prepare.

Best,
Aisha Gomez
Engineering Manager, Model Integrations
Acme Retail

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: aisha.gomez@acme.com, tim.shaw@cloudco.com, procurement@bigcorp.com
Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2028 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cutover staffing and communication clarifications for v1 -> v2 model phase — Action items

Thanks everyone — short summary and owners (please confirm inline):

- Owners: Ben = ops on-call & automated fallback implementation (Ben to deliver thresholds + initial account list by 09/19).
- Marissa = customer comms lead (first draft in comms-draft-v1v2.docx; Marissa to send to legal and Laura for pricing language by 09/18).
- Laura = enterprise liaison for Acme/BigCorp (confirm canary acceptance and pricing stance by 09/20).
- Priyom = release manager (coordinate capacity reservation request with infra; approve by 09/21).
- Evelyn = incident playbook owner (produce abbreviated 48h playbook for cutover ops by 09/22).

Attachments: cutover_staffing_matrix.xlsx (updated with owners), customer-impact-matrix.pdf, comms-draft-v1v2.docx.

Risks to escalate to leadership: capacity commit timeline (09/21) and legal sign-off on the pinned-model exception language. If either misses, we delay Phase 1 by one week.

Please reply with a one-line ACK and any changes to owners. If I don't hear objections by EOD Tuesday (09/19), I'll lock the dates and send the external comms schedule.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
